name: Deck click drop
mechanic: Each click of the deck causes new cards to drop down, rounds remaining decrease, and slots on the right score whatever card is put on them.

name: Score slot as free space
mechanic: The score slot can be used as a free/empty space between deck clicks.

name: Mulligan entrance cards
mechanic: Mulligan incoming cards by clicking them and pressing a discard button.

name: Rearrange entrance cards
mechanic: Player can rearrange incoming/entrance cards before placing them.

name: Deck variants change rules
mechanic: Different decks influence the starting deck and rules; decks can be combined and picked up during a run.

name: Face cards worth 10
mechanic: Face cards all count as 10 when adding to a hand total.

name: Score for 15
mechanic: Score 2 points for every combination that sums to 15.

name: Score for 31
mechanic: Score 2 points for every combination that sums to 31.

name: Score for pair
mechanic: Score 2 points for a pair.

name: Score for triple
mechanic: Score 6 points for a triple.

name: Score for quad
mechanic: Score 12 points for a quad.

name: Score for run
mechanic: Score 3-7 points for a run of 3 to 7 cards.

name: Magic deck
mechanic: Magic deck: each suit is an element; cast spells by submitting elemental suit combinations.

name: Survivor deck
mechanic: Survivor deck: each suit represents a resource such as food, water, or a weapon.

name: Collect number cards to progress
mechanic: Collect all number cards to progress to a stage where remaining boss face cards must be faced (Deadman Wonderland reference).

name: FTL-style map with special cards
mechanic: Map is FTL-like; each location is marked by a single special card the player collects, which has special effects.

name: Location difficulty from card
mechanic: A map location's suit and rank determine its difficulty and type.

name: Minesweeper map reveal
mechanic: Deck starts fully visible but face-down like Minesweeper; can only click a card adjacent to a face-down card, battling for it and revealing adjacent cards; win by uncovering all cards.

name: Map special squares
mechanic: Some map squares are special locations like shops; e.g. all 7s could be shops.

name: Map probability rings
mechanic: Map could be a square with rings of probability where higher-rank cards are more likely toward the middle.

name: Revealed cards act
mechanic: All revealed cards perform their abilities.

name: Pickup vs legal placement
mechanic: A stack can be picked up from anywhere, but if the resulting stack is illegal it can only be placed back on the submission spot.

name: Map card seeds next entrance
mechanic: Clicking a card on the map makes it the first card to appear in the drop-down/entrance area of the subsequent match.

name: Cards as currency
mechanic: Instead of currency, cards themselves are the currency and are traded.

name: Gold heavy to bottom
mechanic: Gold cards are heavy and always sink to the bottom of the deck.

name: Frankenstein card
mechanic: On submission, this card combines with the bottom and top cards into a 3-card merged stack that remains in the submission zone after scoring.

name: Sliced Bread card
mechanic: On submission, if there is a same-suit card later down the stack, gain a point for each card in between.

name: Double trigger seal
mechanic: Seal: this card's effect triggers twice.

name: Trigger when hidden seal
mechanic: Seal: this card's effect triggers even when hidden (covered).

name: Trigger in deck seal
mechanic: Seal: this card's effect can trigger while still in the deck.

name: Money on trigger seal
mechanic: Seal: gain money whenever this card's effect triggers.

name: Heavy material
mechanic: Heavy card type sinks to the bottom of the deck.

name: Light material
mechanic: Light card type rises to the top of the deck.

name: Elemental materials
mechanic: Elemental card materials: Earth, Air, Water, Fire.

name: No submit slot, whole board scores
mechanic: There is no special submit slot; the entire board is considered for submission on final score, using entrance cards similar to jokers.

name: Draw-through then submit
mechanic: Constantly draw through the deck like classic solitaire, then submit to evaluate the entire board state and reset.

name: 5-wide board for row hands
mechanic: A 5-column-wide board allows row-wide poker hands as well as column hands.

name: Legal stacks only, harder over time
mechanic: Only legal stacks can be picked up, and moving stacks becomes more difficult with time.

name: 15 as rank via ability only
mechanic: Rank 15 is too hard to visually read and should only exist via an ability, not as a default rank.

name: Base scoring: vertical runs + horizontal poker
mechanic: Base scoring is vertical runs (with a minimum size) plus horizontal poker hands.

name: Elemental movement types
mechanic: Elemental card types have custom movement, such as always staying on top or bottom of a stack.

name: Match end condition
mechanic: Match ends when the deck runs out of cards or the required score is reached.

name: Submit clears and cascades board
mechanic: Pressing submit scores everything and clears the board, with upper cards coming down to start a new board state without a full wipe.

name: Legal stack ascending/descending, no same suit
mechanic: Legal stacks are ascending or descending rank order and cannot stack same suit.

name: Vertical poker hands ability
mechanic: Ability that makes poker hands also considered vertically (columns), not just rows.

name: Cards auto-drop, no manual drag down
mechanic: Cards come down on their own and cannot be dragged down manually.

name: Row-then-column top-down scoring order
mechanic: Submission evaluates top-down, one row at a time and 5 cards at a time, so poker hands score first while runs are calculated per column simultaneously.

name: Multiply vertical by horizontal
mechanic: All vertical scores are multiplied together with all horizontal scores at the end.

name: Effect trigger order
mechanic: Card effects trigger in order: field effects, then deck top-down (soon-to-be-drawn first, order hidden), then left-right top-down including entrance, then discard pile top-down (recent discards first).

name: Row-first then simultaneous column scoring
mechanic: All row scoring happens first, then all 5 lanes are scored simultaneously with the same per-row scoring repeated for each column, returning scored cards that go through the card-effect loop and get elevated.

name: Triangle map tier choice
mechanic: Choose from the next 3 card options, moving the player up a tier of a triangle-shaped map and playing a match, repeating.

name: Lane loss on lateral movement
mechanic: Moving to the left lane permanently loses access to both right lanes; moving to the middle lane loses both left and right lanes.

name: Boss phase every few rows
mechanic: Every few rows of the triangle map is a boss phase, visually designed to look like terrain.

name: Fights only on boss phases
mechanic: Fights may be restricted to only happen on boss phases of the map.

name: Poker card (5-card window)
mechanic: When this card is scored, it and the 4 cards above it are scored together as a poker hand.

name: Every 5 cards per column scores
mechanic: Every 5 cards in a column are scored as a poker hand.

name: Spiderweb card
mechanic: Spiderweb: scores 1 point per card diagonal to this card, in a cross shape.

name: Guarantee early entrance cards
mechanic: Some way to guarantee that newly chosen cards show up first, or sooner, in the entrance.

name: Null cards
mechanic: Null cards take up space on the board and are highlighted on hover to show over the null space.

name: Hidden trigger stamp
mechanic: Hidden trigger: ability activates even when the card is hidden (covered), unlike default active abilities that need visibility.

name: Only first poker hand scores
mechanic: Make it so only the first scored poker hand actually scores, ignoring later poker hands in the same evaluation.

name: Any card placeable on this card
mechanic: Card ability: any card can be placed on top of this card, modifying stacking rules.

name: Every 5th row red
mechanic: Every 5 rows, make that row red (visual scoring marker/threshold).

name: Points increase by layer
mechanic: Points scored increase based on the layer/height a card is stacked at.

name: Check scoring in deck/discard
mechanic: Scoring should also check cards sitting in the deck and discard pile, not just the board.

name: Add all cards to map
mechanic: Add all cards to the map (as collectibles/nodes), not just special ones.

name: Self-upgrading effect
mechanic: An effect that upgrades itself into a better version of itself if the player meets certain conditions.

name: Pip effects permanently active
mechanic: Pip effects (suit/rank abilities) should be permanently active, independent of the resolver class.

name: Wild pip tracks previous pip
mechanic: A Wild pip type tracks and mimics whichever pip it last resolved to.

name: Wild pip random selection
mechanic: Wild pip randomly chooses itself from among existing pips on the same board/row/column.

name: Reveal-all active ability button
mechanic: QOL: a half-open-eye button that opens fully, causing all cards with an eye stamp (or always-active cards) to push cards stacked on top downward so the active card is fully visible.

name: Compress-board button
mechanic: QOL: a compress-all-cards button converts the board into a flavorless sheet showing only pips and bright ability names (dimmed if inactive), maximizing readability.

name: Exchange Voucher card
mechanic: Exchange Voucher: a special deck card usable to swap itself with any card currently on screen.

name: Buttons and shops as cards
mechanic: All buttons should themselves be cards; e.g. a shop reroll is itself a tappable card on the board.

name: Sin of Gluttony card
mechanic: Sin of Gluttony: a Hippo-type card with no value cap that can be fed from anywhere, including decks, permanently consuming cards without returning them.

name: Uniqueness multiplier
mechanic: A multiplier that increases with every unique effect triggered during a run.

name: Hidden Rules Deck
mechanic: A normally-hidden 'Rules' deck holds the cards that define the default rule set (stacking, scoring, etc.); changing the rules means changing cards in this deck.

name: Metagame editing ruleset deck
mechanic: Metagame where the player tries to modify the default ruleset deck during a run by adding or removing rule cards.

name: Boss debuffs as ruleset cards
mechanic: Negative boss-battle effects are temporary cards added to the ruleset deck, defined to self-destruct after the game/act.

name: Label/Evident rule-visibility card
mechanic: A 'Label/Evident' type card announces its ruleset-deck effect as an active effect on the board even when the universal/rules deck itself is not visible.

name: Rule cards have random suit/rank
mechanic: Rule-deck cards carry a random suit and rank in case the player is able to extract them onto the playing field.

name: Decks as playable solitaire boards (vetoed)
mechanic: Considered (then vetoed) making every deck its own playable solitaire board so players could reorder or extract cards from it.

name: Cards have 1 parent/1 child stack
mechanic: Cards can have exactly 1 parent and 1 child card, forming a stack.

name: Board has deck/discard/ruleset zones
mechanic: The board has a deck zone, a discard deck zone, and a ruleset deck zone.

name: Ruleset deck parsed at game creation
mechanic: On game creation, the ruleset deck is parsed to decide the board layout.

name: Entrance cards act via ability
mechanic: Entrance/input cards get their draw-and-pass functionality implemented as an ability: on turn start, pass child cards to the board card in the same column, then draw a random card from the deck.

name: Dynamic input/board card count from rules
mechanic: The number of input cards and board cards is decided dynamically at game creation by iterating the rule deck (e.g. a rule dictating 5 input columns and 5 board columns).

name: Tap-to-force-trigger card
mechanic: A card that can force a linked on-trigger card to fire whenever it is tapped, likely via stacking.

name: Unlockable ruleset card packs
mechanic: A ruleset card pack that can be unlocked, allowing cards that change fundamental rules of the game.

name: Vampire Survivors-style prestige shop
mechanic: Prestige points system: each win grants points spendable in a menu to change the odds of cards appearing or to apply debuffs for more points.

name: Eye stamp shows mini skill art
mechanic: Eye stamp allows a card to stay active despite being covered, showing a miniature version of the skill art inside the stamp.

name: Rules-in-main-deck variant
mechanic: A deck variant where the rule deck is empty and all rules are embedded as cards in the main deck.

name: Triangle map holes hold card packs
mechanic: The triangle map can have holes that contain card packs instead of individual cards.

name: Rarity affects card borders/shine
mechanic: Rarer cards could have different borders and shine/holographic effects.

name: Power-sorted rarity tiers
mechanic: Create common base effects, then progressively stronger versions of those effects as separate, rarer cards; rarity is determined by how far a card climbs the effect-value ladder.

name: Shop buy/sell in cards
mechanic: Shop sells cards priced in a stack of cards taken from the player's deck (equivalent value); card packs on the map add cards while the shop removes them; shop can sell packs too; reroll cost increases each use.

name: Card unlocks: action-based and score-based
mechanic: Dual unlock system: some cards unlock from specific in-game actions, others from reaching score/win thresholds; common cards from generic progress, rare cards from genre-specific play.

name: Prestige system reshapes map odds
mechanic: Prestige currency from wins can be spent to manipulate the odds of cards/events spawning on the map, or to unlock true-vision (seeing the rule deck and true card descriptions).

name: Deck unlocks combined with gimmick runs
mechanic: Deck unlocks (Balatro-style) combined with gimmick-run variants instead of a separate tab.

name: Ascension debuff cards
mechanic: Ascensions: each ascension level adds a chosen negative-effect card to the deck or rules deck, including permanent versions of boss environmental hazards.

name: Eye of God card
mechanic: Eye of God: allows seeing all decks and true (unobscured) card descriptions.

name: Hand of God card
mechanic: Hand of God: allows moving cards to any location on the board and reordering cards within a deck.

name: Foot of God card
mechanic: Foot of God: can switch locations with any card on screen.

name: Score as damage vs antagonist
mechanic: Recontextualize the points system as damage dealt against an antagonist, similar to Slay the Spire enemy health.

name: Combo increments per unique effect
mechanic: Row/column scoring becomes a combo system: score increments by 1 for each unique effect triggered, with heavier emphasis on card effects that do direct damage under specific conditions.

name: Flat points multiplied by combo
mechanic: Flat points come from scoring, while row combo and column combo values are multiplied into the flat points.

name: Avalanche card
mechanic: Avalanche: after scoring all cards on the board, attack the scoreboard, reducing the goal score by the number of cards scored.

name: Status effect array on cards
mechanic: Cards carry a status array (dictionary of status-effect name to value) processed by a rule card each turn.

name: Effect art pops up on trigger
mechanic: When an effect plays, its art pops up on screen in the background as if it is being performed.

name: Grand Entrance / The Ring zones
mechanic: Circus rename: upper and lower play zones become 'Grand Entrance' and 'The Ring'.

name: Performers and Feats rename
mechanic: Circus rename: cards are 'performers'; skills are 'feats'.

name: Tips for overscoring
mechanic: Scoring is themed as audience excitement with cheering; player gains 'tips' currency for overscoring, playing as the Ringmaster.

name: Circus suits, rank cap question
mechanic: Suits become clowns/dancers/flames/juggling balls/hoops/knives; aces are the actual performers; considering capping rank at 10.

name: Performance ring score multiplier
mechanic: Each 'ring' of 5 rows increases the score multiplier for cards scored within it (1st ring 1x, 2nd ring 2x, 3rd ring 3x, etc.).

name: 3 submits as 3 acts
mechanic: 3 submits per match could reference 3 performance acts.

name: Leader/champion cards
mechanic: Leader/champion cards start the game already on the board (or entrance) and do not leave on submit.

name: Ringmaster leader card
mechanic: Ringmaster: no suit/rank; type makes it start in the entrance like other leaders; stamp lets it always be picked up and placed anywhere with nothing on top; skill keeps it on the board after submission.

name: Leader flavor debuffs
mechanic: Optional leader debuffs, e.g. fear of fire/knives preventing placement on fire/knife cards.

name: Magician leader archetype
mechanic: Magician leader archetype: focuses on card creation and deletion.

name: Acrobatics leader archetype
mechanic: Acrobatics leader archetype: focuses on card movement.

name: Animal trainer leader archetype
mechanic: Animal trainer leader archetype: focuses on stacking, including eating cards and cards auto-moving through the field.

name: Clowns leader archetype
mechanic: Clowns leader archetype: focuses on pip manipulation.

name: Dancer leader archetype
mechanic: Dancer/skill-tricks leader archetype: focuses on specific formations.

name: Escape artist leader archetype
mechanic: Escape artist/stuntsman leader archetype: focuses on negative effects.

name: Fortune teller leader archetype
mechanic: Fortune teller leader archetype: focuses on deck manipulation.

name: Special effects leader archetype
mechanic: Special-effects (fireworks) leader archetype: focuses on points/combo manipulation.

name: Concessions leader archetype
mechanic: Concessions/food leader archetype: focuses on positive effects.

name: Costume designer leader archetype
mechanic: Costume designer leader archetype: focuses on equipment/clothing/stamp slots.

name: Producer/manager leader archetype
mechanic: Producer/manager leader archetype: focuses on token cards like gold-money cards and basic cards.

name: Card groups boosted by leaders
mechanic: Cards belong to groups, and leader cards can boost the members of their group.

name: First-act type
mechanic: First-act card type shows up alone before any other cards.

name: Second-act type
mechanic: Second-act card type shows up alone after half the deck is drawn.

name: Final-act type
mechanic: Final-act card type shows up alone after all other cards are drawn.

name: Presentation-stage preview
mechanic: Preview area is themed as a presentation stage where text scrolls but the card itself does not.

name: Carnival meta shop
mechanic: The overall meta shop is themed as a carnival.

name: Basic suit props sweep board
mechanic: Scored basic (non-skill) cards summon rank-scaled prop objects in their row/column that move across the board and interact with other cards.

name: Suit-specific prop movement
mechanic: Knives and hoops move horizontally across their scored row; balls and fire drop down their column.

name: Prop-hits-target mult gain
mechanic: Gain mult when a hoop passes through an animal/acrobat card, a knife misses a stuntsman, or a ball hits a juggler/animal; fire buffs cards it passes through.

name: Firework suit column score
mechanic: Firework suit directly adds points to its column based on its rank.

name: Balanced prop targeting rules
mechanic: Alt balance: knives hit non-skill cards and hoops hit skill cards; balls buff skill cards and fire buffs non-skill cards, spreading buffs as evenly across the column as possible.

name: Electric suit chain buff
mechanic: Electric suit buffs cards that are connected and chained together in a certain way.

name: Prop cards defined as feat-less
mechanic: Cards without feats (skills) are classified as 'prop' cards.

name: Metashop odds vs required score
mechanic: Spending points in the meta-shop to manipulate overall card odds also increases the score required per show.

name: Hard cap on flush win-con plays
mechanic: Alt win condition idea: win via 1 flush, but a hard cap exists on total flushes ever playable so it cannot be repeated infinitely.

name: Town-specific hazards
mechanic: Different towns present different hazards; e.g. performing at a volcano might cause lava hazards.

name: Suit-nerfing towns
mechanic: Certain towns don't score certain suits at all, e.g. 'knifetown' gives no points for knife scoring, similarly firetown/juggletown/hooptown.

name: +1 reroll, no-repeat rerolls
mechanic: Add +1 reroll per game; for the rest of the game, repeated reroll actions do not give the same results.

name: Permanently-active toggle
mechanic: Once activated, an effect stays active for the rest of the game and can no longer be toggled off.

name: Spotlight/focus rename
mechanic: 'Active' is rebranded as Spotlight/Focus: cards that are unblocked (uncovered) are in the spotlight.

name: Double-everything deck
mechanic: Double-everything deck variant: ranks are doubled (doubling deck size), initial slots doubled, score requirement doubled, and card packs doubled.

name: Slot-machine pack opening
mechanic: Card pack opening could show all possible cards from the pack cycling in the background slot-machine style, though the result is fixed by seed.

name: Custom deck as final deck
mechanic: A player-built custom deck can serve as the final/endgame deck.

name: Mana cards instead of mana bar
mechanic: Instead of a mana bar, use mana cards similar to MTG; any card can serve as a resource.

name: Mystery Box card
mechanic: Mystery Box: at game start, this card becomes a random skill.

name: Pandora Box card
mechanic: Pandora Box: at game start becomes a random skill; at game end resets back to Pandora Box.

name: Utter Chaos card
mechanic: Utter Chaos: becomes a random skill on every 'next' action.

name: Final act score multiplier
mechanic: The final act gets an extra points multiplier, or each act gets an increasing multiplier.

name: Card debuff statuses
mechanic: Debuff status effects on cards: e.g. Exhausted (loses rank at round end if it was on board), plus proposed Cancer and Parasites statuses.

name: Reward fast/lean wins
mechanic: Reward winning fast or with fewer cards via card effects, e.g. extra gold cards for winning faster, or buffs to cards remaining in the deck.

name: Cheat Day card
mechanic: Cheat Day: cards remaining in the deck get a rank increase.

name: Common-doubles-rare chain
mechanic: Common card: doubles the chance of rares appearing.

name: Rare-doubles-epic chain
mechanic: Rare card: doubles the chance of epics appearing.

name: Epic-doubles-legendary chain
mechanic: Epic card: doubles the chance of legendaries appearing.

name: Rule cards always globally spotlit
mechanic: Rule cards are a special card type whose top skill is always globally in the spotlight (active), making them not special from normal deck mechanics otherwise.

name: Cross-game score carryover
mechanic: Scoring done outside the main game (side content) carries over into the next game.

name: Rules deck defines next/submit behavior
mechanic: Game rules (via the rules deck) determine what the Next and Submit buttons do; different rules decks per scenario, permanently changeable during a run.

name: Genie wish card
mechanic: Genie: make a wish by choosing a card to create a copy of in hand.

name: Storyteller point carryover
mechanic: Storyteller: preserves some points for the next game.

name: Retirement requires ability activation
mechanic: Cards cannot retire (leave play) until scored or until an ability is activated on them; with no ability, there is no retirement condition.

name: Shared charge system
mechanic: All charge-based effects share the same charge system, so anything with charges can gain more or less charge from different sources.

name: Acrobatic tap-or-carryover charge
mechanic: Acrobatic card has 1 charge triggerable by tap; if unused, the charge carries to the next round.

name: Mulligan-style card packs
mechanic: Card packs where, instead of choosing cards directly, the player mulligans (rerolls) the pack's results arena-style, with an increasable mulligan count.

name: Mulligan entrance via tap
mechanic: Card effect that allows mulliganing entrance cards when tapped.

name: Upgraded pack results with stamps
mechanic: Pack mulligan results can have a chance to be upgraded, including bonus types and stamps.

name: Map high-rarity loose cards
mechanic: The map can sometimes place single high-rarity cards lying around instead of the usual card pack.

name: Encounters as mini solitaire games
mechanic: Map encounters could be mini solitaire games in their own right.

name: Move-resistant cards
mechanic: Some cards can resist being moved.

name: HONK card
mechanic: HONK: on tap, makes a honk noise; unlimited uses.

name: Secret melds via add-to-deck effects
mechanic: Secret melds to discover, implemented as cards with hidden on-add-to-deck effects that add new scoring rules.

name: Disaster card packs
mechanic: Disaster-themed card packs appear as choices on the board.

name: Biome-based world/act map
mechanic: Game runs on a level/act/world system (One Step From Eden style) traveling through biomes that each affect map generation differently.

name: Fame gate every 10 levels
mechanic: Every 10 levels, the player must have a certain fame level to progress to the next stage.

name: Fog of war on tour map
mechanic: Tour theme with fog of war reducing visibility of further map choices.

name: Show-must-go-on weather hazards
mechanic: Negative weather effects are thematized as 'the show must go on'.

name: Constellation tour map, no backtrack
mechanic: FTL-style constellation map: cannot backtrack, touring cities to build fame, with environmental hazards and surprise weather.

name: Player plans tour route length
mechanic: Players plan their tour route ahead of time, starting with small tours and unlocking longer routes through more cities as they finish tours.

name: In-run temporary prestige events
mechanic: Events can grant temporary prestige points to allocate mid-run instead of only pre-game.

name: Action-triggered negative events
mechanic: Events triggered by player actions, e.g. sacrificing too many talent cards causes a union strike, or having too many cards triggers a tax-evasion penalty losing basic cards.

name: Mini-game events with puzzle win-con
mechanic: Some events are mini-games where score is not the goal but an alternate puzzle win condition, e.g. trigger an effect 5 times to win.

name: World tour fame ramp
mechanic: World tour: build fame across cities before reaching the final city; exceeding a city's score requirement raises the requirement for the next city.

name: Fame improves card rarity odds
mechanic: Odds of better-rarity cards increase with total fame.

name: Endless mode after final city
mechanic: Finishing the final city unlocks an endless mode that repeats the final city with guaranteed repeating choices until the player loses.

name: Circular map / return-to-start
mechanic: Alt map shape ideas: circle the map instead of a final city, or require returning to the start after reaching a big enough city.

name: Maximum Effort/Exhaust stamp
mechanic: Maximum Effort/Exhaust: doubles points (or gives flat points) from this card on score, but only refreshes if the card is not played/scored again on the next show.

name: High-score gated progress
mechanic: Progress is gated behind reaching certain high scores that require luck or complex card play; more complex cards award more points, pushing players toward dynamic decks.

name: Repeatable entrance discard gambling
mechanic: Repeatedly discard entrance cards until satisfied, then commit them to drop; starts with 1 discard per turn (possibly a joker effect), allowing gambling for a better entrance hand.

name: Forbidden click-to-stack solitaire event
mechanic: A forbidden solitaire variant where you just click cards to stack them into your hand, possibly used for events.

name: Rank as duplicate rule-card identifier
mechanic: Duplicate rule cards during creation use their rank as an identifier, e.g. zone-adder 1 has rank 1, zone-adder 5 has rank 5.

name: 1 free undo per turn
mechanic: 1 free undo per turn is baked in by default and does not carry over between turns.

name: Bribery/memory-wipe extra life
mechanic: Bribery/Memory Wipe card: grants an extra life if a city/show is failed, letting the player keep going as if they had won.

name: Map node preview before travel
mechanic: Clicking a map node shows a preview plus a separate button to actually travel to it.

name: Hype mechanic doubles fame requirement
mechanic: Hype mechanic: choose to double the fame required to defeat the next show in exchange for better goodie odds.

name: Presentation card ascending order mult
mechanic: Presentation card: moving cards into ascending order gives multiplier points.

name: Guaranteed card in pack preview
mechanic: Card packs show at least 1 guaranteed card from the pack in the map preview.

name: Branching escalating-difficulty paths
mechanic: Branching map paths with escalating difficulty; split roguelike map campaigns from Klondike-like preset puzzle levels; battle levels use a preset board plus the player's own unlocked deck.

name: Pawn chess card
mechanic: Pawn: if stacked on the card above it, swaps places (moves up), or two above if bottommost; if stacked diagonally upward, replaces (captures) that card, discarding it.

name: Other chess-piece cards
mechanic: Other chess-piece cards can stack anywhere permitted by that piece's chess movement, discarding and taking the place of the card they land on.

name: King chess card
mechanic: King: moves like a chess king, never captures (only swaps with adjacent cards), auto-moves out of check from another chess card on any action, and is worth a ton of points if captured by a chess card.

name: Freakshow off-rank cards
mechanic: Freakshow-class cards do not have normal rank numbers.

name: Digital card cannot be discarded
mechanic: Digital card type: cannot be discarded from the board.

name: Audience patience meter
mechanic: Audience patience system: moving cards drops patience, triggering unique effects delays the drop, and cards auto-drop when patience hits 0.

name: Clown set bonus raises patience
mechanic: Each unique clown card on board raises patience by 1; collecting all of them gives a set bonus chance to not consume patience.

name: Pickpocket card
mechanic: Pickpocket: adds an extra card to the deck if this card is never scored.

name: Diversity-based scoring instead of combo
mechanic: Idea of scoring 'diversity' (variety of suits/types on board) as an alternative axis to the combo system.

name: Injury stacking status
mechanic: Injury stacking status effect: each injury stack increases the chance a card is permanently removed/retired.

name: Applause scales with score
mechanic: Applause/cheer feedback gets more impactful the higher an individual score is.

name: Quest-chain triggered stage acts
mechanic: Story/quest acts are performed by triggering specific effects in a specific order, with the next quest section unlocking only after the previous one completes.

name: Carrier-stacking bonus points
mechanic: Talents doing tricks on top of other 'carrier' talent cards earn extra points.

name: Risk/reward doubled-points tricks
mechanic: Higher-tier tricks give better rewards but higher fail chance; players can manage risk with risk-lowering cards, or opt into doubled points for doubled risk.

name: Clowns as wildcard/joker stand-ins
mechanic: Clowns can stand in for other cards, similar to a joker/wildcard, reflecting how circus clowns spoofed other acts.

name: Fun-house-mirror effect modifiers
mechanic: Fun-house mirrors: skills that modify nearby effects in some way.

name: Per-act injury chance
mechanic: Each act/trigger has a chance of creating an injury stack; injury stacks increase the chance of permanent retirement/death.

name: Injury clears if unused
mechanic: An injury stack is lost if the card goes through an act without performing.

name: Net card lowers retirement, raises injury
mechanic: Net card: increases chance of injury but lowers chance of retirement.

name: Crit chance to increase score
mechanic: A chance to crit, increasing score.

name: 5 starting suits
mechanic: Starting with 5 suits instead of 4 is more balanced: makes flushes harder and allows an anti-flush hand.

name: Merci: shift an obstructing card
mechanic: Merci (solitaire cheat): allowed once, to move an obstructing card out of the way.

name: Accordion pile-matching rule
mechanic: Accordion Solitaire: draw a card, create a new pile if it doesn't match the newest pile's top card by suit or rank; can only stack on the newest pile.

name: Accordion pile-combining rule
mechanic: Accordion Solitaire: piles whose top cards match and are 3 apart (or adjacent) can be combined, newer cards going on top.

name: Calculation Solitaire base piles
mechanic: Calculation Solitaire: suits don't matter; start with ace/2/3/4 foundation piles, one waste pile each.

name: Calculation Solitaire looping stacks
mechanic: Calculation Solitaire: foundation piles stack in increments of their base number (1s, 2s, 3s, 4s), looping around past King.

name: Calculation Solitaire waste-pile rule
mechanic: Calculation Solitaire: cards that don't fit go on a waste pile; only the waste pile's top card can move to a foundation, and only if legal.

name: Canfield tableau stacking rule
mechanic: Canfield Solitaire: tableau stacks 1 rank lower and opposite color; a whole stack can move if it follows this rule.

name: Canfield 3-card stock draw
mechanic: Canfield Solitaire: stock is drawn 3 cards at a time, only the top of the 3 usable (then the next below it once used).

name: Canfield foundation-rank feed
mechanic: Canfield Solitaire: a card matching the foundation base's rank, wherever found in reserve or stock, goes straight to the foundation.

name: Canfield foundation build rule
mechanic: Canfield Solitaire: foundations build with same suit, ascending rank only.

name: Klondike stacking rule
mechanic: Klondike Solitaire: tableau stacks opposite color, one rank lower.

name: Klondike reveal-on-move rule
mechanic: Klondike Solitaire: moving a face-up card off a pile reveals the card beneath as face up.

name: Klondike empty-space king rule
mechanic: Klondike Solitaire: empty tableau spaces can only be filled by a king-headed stack.

name: La Belle Lucie stacking rule
mechanic: La Belle Lucie: only top cards of each pile are playable, moved to foundation or stacked one rank lower, same suit.

name: La Belle Lucie redeal limit
mechanic: La Belle Lucie: three tries to win; redeal reshuffles all cards and redistributes in threes.

name: La Belle Lucie merci rule
mechanic: La Belle Lucie: if no moves or redeals remain, one merci move is allowed, shifting a card position up or down by one.

name: Poker Patience base rule
mechanic: Poker Patience: lay out 25 cards into a 5x5 square, forming 10 poker hands from the 5 rows and 5 columns.

name: Poker Patience adjacency placement
mechanic: Poker Patience variant: each new card placed must be adjacent or diagonal to a previously placed card, so the first card can end up anywhere in the final square.

name: Poker Patience win threshold
mechanic: Poker Patience: win if the total added score across rows and columns reaches 200 under Barry Scoring.

name: Poker Patience diagonal scoring variant
mechanic: Poker Patience variant: also count the 2 longest diagonals for additional scoring.

name: Poker Patience PvP mode
mechanic: Poker Patience PvP: one player calls out the next card and both players build their own square with the same cards in the same order.

name: Poker hand scoring table
mechanic: Poker Patience scoring table (UK vs Barry scoring) for pair/two pair/three of a kind/straight/flush/full house/four of a kind/straight or royal flush.

name: 5x5 grid entrance placement redesign
mechanic: Core redesign: entrance shows top 5 cards as normal, but the player freely chooses where in a 5x5 grid below to place each one.

name: 3 grids side by side, commit to one
mechanic: Each game fills 3 side-by-side 5x5 grids; card effects can influence other grids; player chooses which grid the next 5 entrance cards go into but must commit to a single grid once chosen.

name: Rows spanning multiple grids
mechanic: Allow super-long rows that span across multiple grids.

name: Cards bounce/swap between grids
mechanic: Card effects that can bounce cards to other grids or swap places between grids.

name: No-adjacency placement with shifting
mechanic: Alternative: no restriction requiring cards be placed near others, but with a shifting mechanic where a second card placed 5 away determines the first card's final position.

name: Ring unlocks per 25 deck cards
mechanic: Increase the number of grids/rings relative to cards in the deck, e.g. every 25 cards in the deck unlocks a new ring (with a max ring cap to avoid excess).

name: Column-locked entrance placement
mechanic: Restrict each column to accept only 1 entrance card, from any of the 5 entrance cards, rather than free column choice.

name: Cross-path entrance bonus
mechanic: Card effect that rewards entrance cards crossing each other's paths on the way to their destination column.

name: End show early with good entrance
mechanic: Entrance cards are global by default; during the final performance, the player can choose to end early if the current entrance cards are good.

name: Per-ring independent entrances
mechanic: Each ring/grid has its own independent 5-card entrance, and the player can play them in any order between rings, triggering effects whenever.

name: 3D stacking as extra rows/cols
mechanic: Allow stacking cards on top of each other on the grid, adding a 3D element that functions as theoretical additional rows/columns.

name: Global vs ring-local card effects
mechanic: Grid-based card effects can be scoped as global (all grids) or local to a single ring.

name: Trigger cross-ring effects while placing
mechanic: Allow using trigger effects from other rings while placing a card in the currently chosen ring.

name: Non-5x5 ring layouts with hazards
mechanic: Allow alternative ring layouts that are not 5x5, including prefilled zones with cards or hazards.

name: Immediate vs delayed row/col scoring
mechanic: Choice between scoring a completed row/column immediately on completion versus scoring everything at the end; card effects could trigger specifically on completion, rewarding early vs late finishers.

name: Built-in symmetric PvP mode
mechanic: Built-in PvP mode: both players start with the same deck and aim for the highest score.

name: Unused entrance cards persist
mechanic: Unused entrance cards stay in place for the next round rather than being replaced.

name: Mahjong hand check across ring
mechanic: Check whether a ring satisfies mahjong-style hands, e.g. 4 triplets and a pair across its 5 rows or 5 columns.

name: Empty-zone rank buff (mancala effect)
mechanic: Manipulate what an empty zone does to the next card placed on it, e.g. a mancala-style effect where a zone temporarily raises the rank of whatever is placed there (shown as +X).

name: Poker shuffle: pre-commit reshuffle
mechanic: Poker Shuffle rule: allows shifting placed cards around before all 25 grid spaces are filled, effectively allowing a perfect hand.

name: Spite and Malice communal foundations
mechanic: Spite and Malice: dispose of cards into up to 4 communal foundations built 1 through Queen (suits irrelevant, king wild); completed foundations are set aside.

name: Spite and Malice waste-pile rule
mechanic: Spite and Malice: personal waste piles accept 1 discard per turn and can only stack same-or-one-lower rank; top waste card can move to a foundation.

name: Beggar My Neighbor number-card play
mechanic: Beggar My Neighbor: play continues normally on number cards (2-10).

name: Beggar My Neighbor forfeit rule
mechanic: Beggar My Neighbor: playing a face card forces the next player to pay a forfeit (4 cards for ace, 3 for K, 2 for Q, 1 for J).

name: Beggar My Neighbor pile-win rule
mechanic: Beggar My Neighbor: if all forfeit cards are non-face, the face-card player takes the whole middle pile; a face card among the forfeit passes the effect to the new face card.

name: Snap matching-pile call
mechanic: Snap: if a newly revealed card matches rank with any other player's pile, first to call 'snap' wins both piles.

name: Slapjack slap-on-jack rule
mechanic: Slapjack: everyone places a card in the middle; if it's a jack, first to slap the pile wins it.

name: War tie-breaking rule
mechanic: War: higher rank wins both cards; on a tie, both players place face-down cards and the next comparison's winner takes everything.

name: Go Fish ask-and-fish rule
mechanic: Go Fish: ask another player for a rank you hold; if they have it they hand it over, otherwise you draw ('fish') from stock.

name: Cheat bluff-discard rule
mechanic: Cheat: discard face-down while announcing (possibly falsely) what rank you're playing; next player can claim one rank higher, lower, or the same.

name: Cheat call-out resolution
mechanic: Cheat: calling 'cheat' makes the accused pick up the whole pile if lying, or the caller picks it up if the accused was truthful.

name: Old Maid pair-discard rule
mechanic: Old Maid: discard strict pairs from your hand; goal is to not be left holding the queen.

name: Spit legal-stack speed rule
mechanic: Spit/Speed: no turn order; players race to empty their hand onto shared center stacks under standard legal-stacking rules.

name: Rummy meld types
mechanic: Rummy: scoring melds are a 3+ same-suit consecutive run, or a 3-4 same-rank set.

name: Rummy win condition
mechanic: Rummy: first to arrange the whole hand into melds with exactly 1 card left to discard wins.

name: Rummy early-meld risk
mechanic: Rummy: melds can be placed face-up early to guarantee they count, but this risks other players adding to them for their own points.

name: Gin Rummy early-end scoring
mechanic: Gin Rummy: a player can end the round early if mostly done with combinations, and is rewarded for having more complete combinations than opponents.

name: 500 Rummy free-meld-adding
mechanic: 500 Rummy: any player, regardless of turn order, can add to existing melds and take more than the top discard.

name: 500 Rummy turn-stealing
mechanic: 500 Rummy: a player can steal a turn if an opponent discards a card that could extend another meld.

name: Canasta rank-based wildcards
mechanic: Canasta: certain ranks (e.g. 2s) act as wildcards.

name: Crazy Eights wild-suit rule
mechanic: Crazy Eights: eights are wild and choose the next suit; must stack matching suit or rank; drawing up to 3 cards if unable to play.

name: Mau Mau wildcard/win-call rule
mechanic: Mau Mau: jacks are wild, no redeal limit; must call 'Mau' on your last card, 'Mau Mau' if that card is wild.

name: Neuner 9s-wild variant
mechanic: Neuner: like Mau Mau but 9s are wild plus an added Joker, and players may draw at will.

name: Switch chaining +2/+4/skip/reverse
mechanic: Switch: ace is wild; 2s are +2 (chainable), 4s are +4 (chainable), 8 skips a turn, jack reverses turn order.

name: Fan Tan foundation-build rule
mechanic: Fan Tan: 7s are foundation cards; can only extend with a same-suit card one rank higher or lower; unable-to-play forfeits a chip.

name: Trump Fan Tan wild-suit rule
mechanic: Trump Fan Tan: one suit is wild; a wild-suit card taking another card's place forces that card to be played to the wild foundation.

name: Crazy Tan escalating draw penalty
mechanic: Crazy Tan: unable-to-move players draw and skip, with the required draw increasing by 1 for each consecutive skip until someone moves.

name: Whist trump-suit reveal
mechanic: Whist: the first card revealed determines the trump suit for the hand.

name: Whist trick-taking rule
mechanic: Whist: highest card of the leading suit wins the trick, unless a trump is played, in which case the highest trump wins; trick winner leads next.

name: Oh Hell bid-exact-tricks rule
mechanic: Oh Hell!: players bid exactly how many tricks they intend to win after seeing their hand, capped at the hand size.

name: Oh Hell scoring rule
mechanic: Oh Hell!: 1 point per trick won, plus 10 bonus points for hitting your exact bid.

name: Bid-before-play mechanic proposal
mechanic: Proposed bid mechanic for this game: bet before play to gain extra points for hitting an exact number of melds.

name: Romanian Whist variable hand size
mechanic: Romanian Whist: each round deals a different number of cards; must follow trump suit if unable to follow the leading suit.

name: Ninety-Nine suit-value bidding
mechanic: Ninety-Nine: discard 3 of 12 cards to set your bid, where club=+3, heart=+2, spade=+1, diamond=+0.

name: Hearts avoid-scoring rule
mechanic: Hearts: avoid winning tricks containing hearts (1 point each) or the queen of spades (13 points).

name: Hearts-style negative-suit boss mechanic
mechanic: Boss mechanic where certain suits cause a meld to score 0 or negative if scored.

name: Pinochle meld types
mechanic: Pinochle: melds include runs (A-K-Q-J-10), marriages (King-Queen), the pinochle meld (J diamond + Q heart), and sets (4 Qs).

name: Adjacency-required marriage melds
mechanic: Add marriage-style melds that require cards to be exactly adjacent rather than merely in the same row/column.

name: Auction Pinochle bidder-only meld
mechanic: Auction Pinochle: only the auction winner picks trump and can score melds; other players act as defenders.

name: Setback point-card trick bidding
mechanic: Setback/Pitch: different cards are worth different points, and players bid on how many point-carrying tricks they can win.

name: Cribbage phase-1 stack-to-31
mechanic: Cribbage phase 1: play cards building a running total up to 31 (ace=1, faces=10).

name: Cribbage phase-1 scoring events
mechanic: Cribbage phase 1 scores for: total of exactly 15, pairing the opponent's last card, first card being a jack, or a sequence of 3+ consecutive cards (order-independent).

name: Cribbage phase-2 hand scoring
mechanic: Cribbage phase 2: score the played hand for 15-combinations, pairs, runs, 4/5-card flushes, and a jack.

name: President climbing-rank rule
mechanic: President: each turn plays equal-or-higher rank or passes; 2s are highest, suit irrelevant.

name: President matched-count play rule
mechanic: President: subsequent players must match the number of cards the first player placed, at increasing rank.

name: President scum tribute rule
mechanic: President: the last player to empty their hand ('Scum') must give their two highest cards to the winner.

name: President Palace hidden-hand variant
mechanic: Palace variant of President: play with 3 private cards, 3 face-up cards, and 3 face-down cards, playable only after the previous set is used.

name: Blackjack bust rule
mechanic: Blackjack: score exactly 21 to win; going over 21 loses instantly.

name: Entrance-set betting proposal
mechanic: Proposed betting system comparing the value of the current entrance set versus the next entrance set.

name: Monopoly pay-to-unlock squares
mechanic: Monopoly-inspired: certain map squares require sacrificing/paying a card to unlock before use.

name: Tetris shape-matching bonus tiles
mechanic: Tetris-inspired: certain board tiles want a random preset Tetris-piece shape placed on top (rotatable) for a bonus, matched by suit or rank.

name: Pyramid pair-removal rule
mechanic: Pyramid/Golf Solitaire: remove pairs of cards from the board if they match or sum to 13.

name: Pyramid entrance-match removal
mechanic: Pyramid/Golf Solitaire variant: remove a board card if it matches the current entrance card by a rule such as rank +/-1.

name: Free Cell reserve slots
mechanic: Free Cell-style reserve/free slots that can hold cards (possibly via stacking) and be grabbed anytime.

name: Devil's Grip +3 rank stacking
mechanic: Devil's Grip Solitaire: stacking requires strictly +3 rank, with the starting row determining the sequence.

name: Beehive four-of-a-kind removal
mechanic: Beehive Solitaire: allows removing a four-of-a-kind 'swarm' from the board.

name: 31/99-style fixed point values
mechanic: 31/99-style rank values: ace worth 1 or 11, 10 worth -10, King worth 99, others their rank; goal is reaching a target total.

name: Loaned temporary cards
mechanic: Loaned cards: temporary cards that last only a few rounds (Game of Life reference).

name: Sets-of-3 rank boost (Risk)
mechanic: Risk-inspired: sets of 3 matching cards trigger effects such as increased ranks.

name: Sudoku-rule grid bonus
mechanic: Sudoku-inspired: if the ranks in the grid satisfy Sudoku constraints, grant a bonus.

name: Minesweeper bomb-prefilled grid
mechanic: Minesweeper-inspired: rings prefilled with random bombs; number tiles indicate nearby bombs; placing a card on a bomb lowers its value.

name: Checkers hop-capture card
mechanic: Checkers-inspired 'frog' card: allowed to hop over existing cards.

name: Wordle-style hidden target card
mechanic: Wordle-inspired card: sets a randomized target rank/suit combo and reports whether the last placed card is wrong, close (wrong position), or correct; first correctly-placed row/column wins.

name: Neighbor-type value bonus (3-Ring Circus)
mechanic: 3-Ring Circus board game reference: cards care about the type of cards to their left/right to increase their own value.

name: Autochess-style ring type combo
mechanic: Autochess-inspired: multiple copies of a class/type of card within a single ring create special scaling effects, e.g. tying hoop/ball/fire/knife prop synergies to a same-type count in that ring.

name: Boss: adjacency-only placement
mechanic: Boss variant of entrance cards: only allows placing cards adjacent to each other when placing on the grid.

name: Double trigger (seal)
mechanic: Seal: this card's effect triggers twice.

name: Earth material (bottom of deck)
mechanic: Earth material type stays on the bottom of the deck.

name: Sandwich card
mechanic: On submission, if there is a same-suit card later down the stack, gain a point for each card in between.

name: Selection sort card
mechanic: Card moves up one position if the card above it has a smaller rank.

name: More Poker card
mechanic: Poker hands give double the points.

name: Spaceship card
mechanic: This card can be placed in 'the void' (an otherwise-illegal empty/off-board slot).

name: Deck auto-slotter
mechanic: While in the deck, if an open card with a legal slot is ever available, this card moves from the deck into that slot.

name: Discard-to-deck on score
mechanic: On score, put 2 random cards from the discard pile back into the deck; an Exhaust variant skips the whole discard step.

name: Egg card
mechanic: When submitted, this card instead becomes a completely random other card of higher rank.

name: Champion card
mechanic: Cards of the same rank directly above or below this card are discarded.

name: Hippo card
mechanic: When a single card is placed on top of this card, consume it and gain its rank in value (rank wraps around).

name: All In card
mechanic: On the next score, double the total score, then double the score needed for the next round.

name: Deja Vu card
mechanic: This card remembers its board placement; the next time an open slot appears there, it moves there from anywhere.

name: Frankenstein card
mechanic: When submitted, combines with the bottom and top cards into a 3-card merged stack that remains in the submission zone after scoring.

name: Rabbit card
mechanic: If this card is clicked/grabbed, it moves away to the furthest orthogonal location.

name: Robber card
mechanic: Between turns, robbers steal high-value cards from the board.

name: Trigger even when hidden (seal)
mechanic: Seal: this card's effect triggers even when hidden (covered).

name: Air material (top of deck)
mechanic: Air material type stays on top of the deck.

name: Poker card (5-window)
mechanic: When this card is evaluated, it and the 4 cards above it are scored as a poker hand.

name: Trap card
mechanic: Creates an extra empty space; the next card placed there instead goes below this card, and the empty space is removed.

name: Goalpost card
mechanic: Enhances a random viable score type, which changes each game.

name: Distancing card
mechanic: Card hovers at the top of the stack without blocking the card below it, and cannot be clicked (counts as an extra row).

name: Pot of Greed card
mechanic: When this card sits alone in a slot, discard it and replace with two cards from the deck.

name: Rewrite card
mechanic: On entering the board, remembers the cards below it; on submission, replaces the same number of cards below it.

name: Paintbrush card
mechanic: Cards placed on top of this card become the same suit as it.

name: The One Ring card
mechanic: Player always knows exactly where this card is; if it is permanently destroyed, the match is won.

name: Lightning card
mechanic: Lightning strikes the highest-value card on the board, causing a shock effect.

name: Trigger when in deck (seal)
mechanic: Seal: this card's effect can trigger while still in the deck.

name: Water material (moves down)
mechanic: Water material type moves downward one position per turn.

name: Non-scoring bonus card
mechanic: If this card is not part of any scoring hand, it gives 10 points.

name: Parasite card
mechanic: Attaches to the next card placed on top of it; on submission, replaces the host card with the parasite card.

name: Cheering Team card
mechanic: Each scored card of the same suit as this card gets extra points.

name: Anything-stacks-here card
mechanic: Any card can be placed on top of this card.

name: Future Sight card
mechanic: See the next 5 cards in the deck.

name: Snake card
mechanic: Smaller-rank cards below this card are consumed, leaving behind a temporary body card of the same rank.

name: Sniper card
mechanic: On next press, lowers the rank of the last-interacted card by one, discarding it if its rank reaches one.

name: Jenga card
mechanic: Clicking a non-top card moves it to the top of the next-smallest stack, leaving an empty space; rows may have at most 4 empty spaces and must stay connected, or this card is discarded; empty spaces collapse once inactive.

name: Hurricane card
mechanic: Cards in a donut shape get wet; the hurricane starts at a random category 1-5, moves, and weakens over time.

name: Money on trigger (seal)
mechanic: Seal: gain money whenever this card's effect triggers.

name: Fire material (moves up)
mechanic: Fire material type moves upward one position per turn.

name: Spiderweb card
mechanic: Scores 1 point per card diagonal to this card, in a cross shape.

name: Stowaway card
mechanic: This card moves to the free slot if it is open, after being scored.

name: Combo card
mechanic: During scoring, cards gain temporary points equal to the hand they were scored in.

name: Connect 4 mini-mode
mechanic: Mini-game mode idea themed on Connect 4.

name: Gold as money material
mechanic: Gold cards act as money/currency.

name: Effect-trigger point gain
mechanic: Whenever a card triggers its effect, gain a point.

name: Tunneler card
mechanic: Single cards placed on this card move to the bottom of the stack.

name: Noble Family card
mechanic: Each scored face card increases the points of the next scored face card by 1.

name: Fishing minigame card
mechanic: Place this card over the deck to trigger a fishing minigame to get a card from the deck.

name: Tsunami card
mechanic: Washes from the bottom upward, lowering the max card-stack count, then recedes.

name: Column card
mechanic: Column-type card gives points to its column on score.

name: Blackjack meld idea
mechanic: Blackjack-referencing scoring idea (unelaborated).

name: Turntable card
mechanic: Flips the entire board vertically.

name: Row card
mechanic: Row-type card gives points to its row on score.

name: Score input cards on submit
mechanic: On submit, score the entrance/input cards too, not just the board.

name: FEMA mode
mechanic: After a number of weather cards, disaster relief becomes available.

name: Earthquake card
mechanic: Scrambles the board.

name: Tornado card
mechanic: Affects a 1x1 area, or a scaling area based on random tornado scale, wherever it is played.

name: Eruption card
mechanic: Cards receive a burned effect that spreads in an expanding snake pattern, with no counter available.

name: Monopoly card
mechanic: Playing a flush of five of a card removes that card from future generation.

name: Fire spreading card
mechanic: Fire spreads to wood-type cards but is blocked by road-type cards.

name: Windy Day card
mechanic: Cards randomly shift over by 1 row/column because it's too windy.

name: Mini Metro mode
mechanic: Mini-game mode: ends of straights become metro stations connected by the straights as lines, which must serve passengers over N turns.

name: Boss fire-breathing fight
mechanic: A boss appears that must be defeated with specific hands or raw point damage while it slowly breathes fire onto the player's actual score.

name: Vampire Survivors edge-eating
mechanic: Vampires begin eating cards at the board's edge over N turns; the player must play all of them to remove the threat.

name: Amogus fake card
mechanic: A card is secretly fake: when played it loses score and ignores the rules on certain turns; the player must find and remove it.

name: 5D multiverse time-travel card
mechanic: Sends a card into the past to play out that board state until it clashes with the present, keeping only the differences.

name: Hoops
mechanic: Base suit: when a scored Hoops card is untalented, hoop props (count = rank) sweep the scored row and every skill card the hoop passes through scores again; stacking requires different suit and adjacent rank.

name: Knives
mechanic: Base suit: knife props (count = rank) launch from the opposite row edge and score plain (non-skill) prop cards they pass, with the spawner scoring itself; stacking requires different suit and adjacent rank.

name: Balls
mechanic: Base suit: ball props (count = rank) arc down the column applying a Juggling status that pays out column score when that card later scores; stacking requires different suit and adjacent rank.

name: Flames
mechanic: Base suit: fire props arc down the column applying Flaming stacks that multiply each burning prop's effect (not applicable to fire-suit or talent cards, but inherited by spawned props); stacking requires different suit and adjacent rank.

name: Fireworks
mechanic: On score, the rocket rises its column and banks the column score directly based on rank; alt version has each firework trigger add +1 firework to the next trigger; stacking requires different suit and adjacent rank.

name: Electricity
mechanic: On score (if untalented), scores points based on this card's rank plus the ranks of all orthogonally/diagonally connected electric-suit cards; stacking requires different suit and adjacent rank.

name: Rock Paper Scissors
mechanic: At game start randomly becomes rock, paper, or scissors; when stacking on another RPS card it must win RPS to stack (ties resolved by higher rank); stacks normally on non-RPS cards.

name: Best Bower
mechanic: Wild suit that counts as every suit for melds/flushes and can stack anywhere; if untalented, randomly selects a prop from the entire game to trigger.

name: Integer numbers (default rank)
mechanic: Default rank A-K (1-13), possibly extended to -99..99; negative ranks apply a negative status/shader inverting effects and reducing score, while still counting uniquely toward combo.

name: Roman Numerals rank
mechanic: Ranks 1-12 that wrap on increase/decrease; time effect advances the rank by +1 per player action.

name: Blank rank
mechanic: Rank effectively 0; always passes stacking rank comparisons but cannot participate in rank-based melds or effects.

name: Wild rank (copycat/understudy)
mechanic: Rank effectively 0 that simultaneously mimics any rank already present in the player's deck for rank-based effects like stacking and melds; behaves like Blank if nothing to copy.

name: Decimal numbers (Half-Step hat)
mechanic: Rank evaluates as both itself and +1 simultaneously for all purposes (e.g. a 3 with this hat also counts as 2.5/2), letting one card double-count toward multiple melds like pairs and straights.

name: Mahjong rank/suit
mechanic: Placeholder entry referencing a mahjong-based rank/suit mechanic; no effect detail given in the sheet.

name: Paper (default type)
mechanic: Default no-effect base material type; exists so every card has a type slot filled.

name: Iron type
mechanic: Sinks to the bottom of any stack, respecting physical weight order.

name: Gold type
mechanic: Sinks to the bottom of stack, heavier than Iron (stops at other heavy cards); costs +2 when traded in at shops.

name: Diamond type
mechanic: Doubles this card's score; costs +3 when traded in at shops.

name: Glass type
mechanic: Spotlights cards behind it, but breaks if a heavy-type card passes through it.

name: Balloon type
mechanic: Opposite of a heavy card: always rises to the top of the stack.

name: Water type
mechanic: Always flows sideways into the shortest adjacent column.

name: PropArtist hat
mechanic: This card's suit prop effects still apply even if the card is talented (has a skill).

name: Kuroko hat
mechanic: This card is unseen: does not block Spotlight beneath it and cannot be targeted by effects.

name: Fifteen (cribbage) talent
mechanic: Spotlight ability checks the scoring hand (row or column) for cards summing to 15 for bonus points; alt version melds this card with adjacent neighbors whose ranks sum to 15 with it.

name: The Half Card talent
mechanic: On drop, splits into two half-cards along the diagonal (one keeps rank+hat, the other keeps only suit), changing stacking rules; recombines and scores its own meld if the two halves are stacked together on score; alt version splits the rank value in half between the two cards.

name: Rarity gates non-null rolls
mechanic: Rarity tiers currently gate only whether a stamp/skill/type roll is non-null, based on luck.

name: Burning cascades as combo source
mechanic: Open scoring knob: whether Burning-status cascades should count as a combo source.

name: Rank-merging meld rule
mechanic: A comparator-bucket rank-merging meld rule multiplies a scored line's points based on line size (measured x2.0 at 5 cards up to x6.0 at 13, x5.1 at 30).

name: Split meld undercounts matches
mechanic: A split meld can show three matching cards on the board but only counts two toward the scored meld, with no on-screen cue explaining the discrepancy.

name: Patience meter mechanic
mechanic: Patience system: idle/non-scoring moves drain a patience meter (patience_max, ships at 3); reaching 0 auto-drops cards; rule cards can raise patience_max via a grant path.

name: Booster reroll pool
mechanic: Booster reroll pool ships at 5 with a planned but unwritten reroll-count modifier content hook (a luck()-style effect).

name: Entrance drop-down between acts
mechanic: Planned but unimplemented: an entrance drop-down step between acts.

name: Hype-wagering system
mechanic: Planned but unimplemented: a hype/wagering system.

name: Fog of war on map
mechanic: Planned but unimplemented: fog of war limiting map visibility.

name: Tour planning system
mechanic: Planned but unimplemented: a tour-planning system for choosing a route.

name: Shop & economy system
mechanic: Planned but unimplemented: a shop and economy system.

name: Meta progression system
mechanic: Planned but unimplemented: a meta-progression system.

name: Leaders/acts system
mechanic: Planned but unimplemented: a leaders/acts system.

name: Deterministic per-subsystem RNG streams
mechanic: Planned but unimplemented: deterministic per-subsystem RNG streams, required before any seed-sharing feature.

name: 5x5 grid replaces drop zones
mechanic: Replace the 5-6 drop-in zones with a 5x5 grid the player manually places entrance cards into.

name: New grid per 25/50 deck cards
mechanic: A new 5x5 grid is unlocked for every 25/50 cards (tunable) in the starting deck.

name: Commit-to-grid entrance rule
mechanic: Once the player places a card in a grid, all current entrance cards must be placed in that same grid before the entrance refreshes with 5 new cards.

name: Grid refill on completion
mechanic: If a grid is completed with entrance cards remaining, it frees up for another grid and its empty slots are refilled with the remaining cards in their current slot.

name: Randomized placement on partial refill
mechanic: If the deck cannot refill the entire entrance zone, new card placement is randomized instead of the default left-to-right order.

name: Row/column scoring happens on placement
mechanic: Scoring occurs immediately as rows/columns are filled in, rather than on submit; pressing submit/end just fires its own hooks and ends the game without a separate scoring round, and can be pressed at any time.

name: Placed cards are locked by default
mechanic: By default, a card placed on an empty grid zone cannot be moved or have cards stacked on it; those actions are reserved for future effects.

name: Height as a 4th coordinate
mechanic: Stacking cards on top of each other adds a 4th coordinate (height); 5 cards aligned in height complete a scorable line at that height, including a same-x,y stack of 5.

name: Height scoring triggers only building up
mechanic: Height-based scoring only triggers when a stack builds upward through a multiple of 5; dropping back down through those intervals does not retrigger scoring.

name: Full-stack scoring on tall stacks
mechanic: Scoring a height-10 (or taller) stack scores the entire stack at once.

name: Height diagonal scoring updates nearest corner
mechanic: A diagonal line across height updates the corner score label closest to the highest height involved, to avoid overlap.

name: 4-coordinate card position
mechanic: Every card's position is defined by 4 coordinates: which grid, x, y, and height.

name: Height removal drops cards above
mechanic: Removing a card from a height stack causes the cards above it to drop down.

name: Re-adding retriggers line scoring
mechanic: Removing a card from a completed 5-line and re-adding it retriggers that line's scoring event.

name: Cross-grid row expansion setting
mechanic: A setting to make other grids expand their rows/zones too if one grid's rows expand due to increasing height.

name: Grid-creation rule card
mechanic: A rule card that, on game start, checks the deck size and adds one 5x5 grid-creation card to the rules deck per 25 cards in the deck.

name: Grid-creation card owns its zones
mechanic: When a 5x5 grid-creation card becomes active it creates the 5x5 zone cards it owns; when inactive, its grid of zone cards is removed and any cards it contains are discarded.

name: Entrance zone cards seed first column
mechanic: 5 entrance/input zone cards work as today, refreshing in random draw order once empty or the current grid is full; the 1st input card corresponds to the 1st column of the 5x5 grid.

name: Any-grid line-completion detector
mechanic: A card that detects a new 5-in-a-line completion anywhere across all grids and triggers its scoring.
